title: Variational Quantum Transduction
summary: Quantum transducers are critical for quantum interconnect, enabling coherent signal transfer across disparate frequency domains. Beyond material and device advances, protocol design has become a powerful means to improve transduction. We introduce a variational quantum transduction (VQT) framework that employs variational tools from near-term quantum computing to systematically optimize protocol performance.
